title: [GMCP 203.037.M] Mastery: Configuration import, export, migration, and desired state
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-037-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP losslessly imports and exports major MCP host configurations while separating secrets, preserving unknown fields and reporting unsupported semantics. One versioned desired-state schema covers servers, transports, auth, sandbox, policy and extensions; migrations are reversible and idempotent; layered overrides explain provenance; and concurrent edits use validation plus atomic conflict handling. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
